'''Hyperlane GH972''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] between the [[Refrax system/Legends|Refrax]] and [[Kestel system/Legends|Kestel systems]], in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Sometime before the capture of the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]'', [[Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209/Legends|Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209]] proceeded on hyperlane GH972 to rendezvous with [[Assault Fleet EM4]] in the Kestel system.
